sentences.text: Learned High Court Government Pleader accepts notice for the respondent.

2. The petitioner is before this Court seeking for the following reliefs:
a. Issue writ of mandamus directing the respondent to consider the representation dated 25.10.2022 as per Annexure-B in respect of property of the petitioner.
b. Issue any writ or order or directions as this Hon'ble Court deems fit in circumstances of the case, in ends of justice and equity.

3. The grievance of the petitioner is that though enhanced compensation has been paid as regards similarly situated land acquired under the very same notification, the said enhanced compensation has not been made available to the petitioner.

4. Whenever any land is acquired and compensation is enhanced, it is required that all the land losers also be made available the same compensation as held by NC: 2023:KHC-K:5622 this Court in MSA.No.200186/2019 disposed of on 11.02.2021.
5.

In that view of the matter, I pass the following:
ORDER i. The Writ Petition is allowed.
ii. A mandamus is issued directing the respondent to consider the representation of the petitioner dated 25.10.2022 at Annexure-B by treating the same as an application under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act.
Sd/-
